content: Melvin-Koushki says it is possible that Mīrzā Iskandar personally commissioned Ibn Turka's first treatise on lettrism, the R. Ḥurūf, and presumes Iskandar also installed him as qadi of Isfahan; he adds that Iskandar was known for imamophilism and an esotericist bent and 'may be imagined' as taking warmly to Ibn Turka.
